name: arcdlc
description: ArcDLC — Architecture Development Life Cycle: a universal delivery workflow for applications and policies. A bundled one-question-at-a-time grilling interview, grilled AIC and architecture documents (arc42, TSC, TOGAF, C4, ADR), grilled policy authoring, an executable acceptance-enforced plan, board-ready engineer stories, code comment markers turned into planned tasks, compliance examination, per-task execution, initiative removal, and plan archiving. one-command setup of a repository or a multi-repository workspace with a docs hub, Installs for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and Antigravity; developed and exercised on Claude Code.
